title: Settings → Tutor, name refused
note: Settings → Tutor (UXS-54, PRM-03, D103): six character tiles with their names and hints, the name field and Reset to Jana; the chosen tile is the wash with an ink border and a tick. A name that fails PRV-03 is refused with the field's error; the draft is kept to correct.
expectText: That name can't be used. Choose 1 to 40 letters, numbers or spaces on one line.
